material.description: A browser call that sets session_id on the envelope and has no gm_session_id= first line in its raw_body is recorded with no session, so prd-resolve refuses it as a self-witness (prd-resolve-self-witness, reason unattributed; dispatch 1792893457248-6075-41077839bc454715). Witnesses from such calls must be re-run with the header. Fix in gm-mcp: take the envelope session_id for plain-text browser bodies, or state the header rule in verbs.md Browser steps.
material.subject: gm browser: a plain-text witness dispatch with only the envelope session_id is unattributed
material.witness: bash raw_body (no gm_session_id line) from session verify-gm-browser-envelope-session-unrecorded recorded that session in the oscraft ledger; JSON bash from verify-gm-browser-envelope-json-probe also recorded. Bash used because browser verbs are barred in this lane.
